# TTL640x480 source reference

Rev B adopts the counter topology and sync/blank decode concepts from
[mengstr/TTL640x480](https://github.com/mengstr/TTL640x480/tree/ea1ecd063d500982263c76a795abd84f77ccb59a),
pinned at `ea1ecd063d500982263c76a795abd84f77ccb59a`. The timing chain is redrawn
in the VJUGA netlist with GAL decode; upstream Eagle files are not imported.

The [adoption note](../docs/rev-b-video-adoption.md) defines the reused timing
logic, the VJUGA framebuffer/bus additions and attribution. The full upstream
MIT notice is retained in [LICENSE-TTL640x480](../docs/LICENSE-TTL640x480).
The machine-readable timing and source identity are in
[`video-timing.json`](../kicad/revb/video-timing.json).

This adoption applies to the Rev B Video card. It does not change the Rev A
copper or establish physical acceptance of either design.
